Details

Starck 3, designed by Philippe Starck delivers a timeless ceramics range through clear, functional design. WaterSense® certified toilets, wall mounted sinks, and minimalist forms make this a go-to collection for accessible, everyday sophistication.

Duravit 030549-0HOLE Features:

  • Covered under Duravit's 5 year warranty and 5 year commercial warranty
  • Constructed of ceramic
  • Coordinates with products from the Starck 3 line
  • Undermount installation
  • Equipped with overflow
  • Mounting hardware included

Duravit 030549-0HOLE Specifications:

  • Overall Length: 20-7/8" (left to right of sink)
  • Overall Width: 14-3/8" (front to back of sink)
  • Overall Height: 7-1/8" (top to bottom of sink)
